name: Espressif ESP32-C3
note: Thresholds and pullup live in mcu-pins.json (D-076). Strapping and boot activity below are check fields (CHK-BRD-04).

value.note: does not select SPI boot but the datasheet recommends pulling it up against glitches (Table 3-3 note 2)
also gates UART0 ROM printing with EFUSE_UART_PRINT_CONTROL (Table 3-4)
held low at reset selects joint download boot

provenance.source: Espressif ESP32-C3 Series Datasheet v2.4 (espressif.com esp32-c3_datasheet_en.pdf, sha256 833fc000b4b3c3d39c496fcbd597fed5806956503ce7390b19cc8ae82f19f968, read 2026-10-09) section 3, Table 3-1 p. 30 (default configuration of strapping pins) and Table 3-3 p. 31 (chip boot mode control)

value.activity: U0TXD: ROM messages print to UART0 at every reset by default
U0RXD: an input at reset, not driven

provenance.source: Espressif ESP32-C3 Series Datasheet v2.4 (espressif.com esp32-c3_datasheet_en.pdf, sha256 833fc000b4b3c3d39c496fcbd597fed5806956503ce7390b19cc8ae82f19f968, read 2026-10-09) Table 2-4 p. 20 (GPIO21 F0 U0TXD type O, GPIO20 F0 U0RXD type I), section 2.3.3 p. 23 (GPIO4 to GPIO7 JTAG, GPIO20 and GPIO21 UART0), Table 3-4 p. 32 (UART0 ROM printing enabled at the default eFuse)
